target_customer: Companies and labs that train, fine tune and serve frontier AI models and want lower compute cost
problem: Training and running frontier models is very expensive. Baud proposes an arithmetic format without multiplications, an ASIC architecture for it and a compiler from PyTorch models.
business_model: AI compute cluster access and chips, early design partner program

founders.name: Sarang Zambare
prior_employers: Peloton (ML lead for Peloton Guide, founding ML engineer)
Caper (founding ML engineer, acquired by Instacart)
previous_startups: Multi time founder per the YC page, ventures not named
founders.background_notes: YC page lists 4 patents and 7 plus years in deep learning and AI hardware.

founders.name: Eric Taylor
founders.background_notes: ASIC architect with four tape outs, per the YC page.

competitors.name: Etched
competitors.traction_then: Claims over 1B USD in chip contracts
competitors.funding_then: About 800M USD raised on exiting stealth per a dealroom item

technical_complexity.rationale: A new number format plus custom ASIC and compiler requires research level work and tape out capital. So far only an FPGA emulation demo of a 50 million parameter model is reported by a third party.

defensibility.rationale: Patentable architecture and the format could be hard to copy, but nothing is yet verified in silicon and incumbents have vastly more resources.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: NVIDIA absorbed Groq in January 2026, a sign incumbents buy architectures; no action on Baud found.

market_need_then: AI chip startups raised about 15B USD in the first nine months of 2026 per a market blog, showing intense demand, though that source is unverified.

branding.domain_note: Uses baudlabs.ai; the legal entity in the site footer is Cerelyze, Inc.
branding.community_and_virality: One Korean tech article from July 2026 (Wowtale).

brand_strength.rationale: Short, distinctive word that is also a telecom unit of signalling rate; the name origin is not stated and press is minimal.

outcome_analysis: Baud is an Active Summer 2026 YC company with an experienced ASIC architect and a serial ML founder. It has an emulated demo and a design partner program but no disclosed funding. Chip startups need large capital and face NVIDIA, Etched and Cerebras, so the outcome is open.
notes: A mirror of the YC directory lists Baud Labs as Summer 2023 in New York, conflicting with the 2026 YC page; the 2026 listing is used. No funding amounts found. Source dates for competitors are approximate from search snippets.
